Questions

Frequently asked questions.

Who is the portfolio plan for?

Apartment operators and management companies with several communities, plus brokerages, med spa groups, salon groups and other brands with more than one location.

How many locations do we need?

There is no hard minimum. The portfolio plan usually makes sense once you have three or more locations that share a brand or a team.

Can we start with a few locations and add more?

Yes. Many portfolios start with a handful of sites or one region, then add locations as they see results.

Can owners and asset managers see the reporting?

Yes. The weekly read is written in plain language so you can forward it as is, by property, by region or for the whole portfolio.

How is it priced?

By number of locations and scope, after a free portfolio visibility check. You get a written plan before you commit.
